Equivalence-trial evaluation of an AI chatbot against enhanced standard of care for uptake of cancer genetic services and testing

screen.reason: The BRIDGE randomized clinical trial evaluated the real-world deployment and uptake of a patient-facing conversational agent/chatbot versus standard-of-care genetic counseling, rather than comparing deployment practices or safeguards.
